Thanks for picking this up. We're excited to get the POC started — the team wants a short kickoff and then a sequence of hands-on deep dives (prompt review, routing checks, and two staged load tests).

Quick context: Kestrel has engineers across Boston, Dublin and Singapore, so we'll need either rotating times or a pair of overlapping windows that allow handoffs. Attached is a brief with our success criteria and an initial prompt set.

Proposed kickoff week: July 27–31. Our first-pass availability:
- Boston (US-Eastern): mornings 9:00–12:00 ET
- Dublin (UTC+1): afternoons 13:00–17:00 UTC+1
- Singapore (SGT): evenings 19:00–22:00 SGT

Can Redwood propose a rotating grid that minimizes repeated late-night sessions for our engineers? Also flag any constraints for running the load window in APAC — we have nightly backups Wed/Thu 02:00–03:30 SGT.

Hi Liam — thanks for the brief and the prompt set. Looping in Marissa (Solutions) and Mina (Platform) to confirm runtime constraints.

High-level plan (proposal):
1) Kickoff (60m) — review scope, success criteria, access & security. Prefer a time that hits late-morning Boston and early-evening Dublin: 11:00 ET / 16:00 Dublin / 23:00 SGT (one-off late for Singapore).
2) Hands-on deep dives (3 sessions, 90m each) — spread across three days with a rotating host so the late slot moves between regions.
3) Load tests — two short runs (20m each) during low-production noise; Redwood will provide a redwood-load-plan.xlsx draft.

Proposed rotating grid (three-day sweep):
Day A: 09:30–11:00 ET | 14:30–16:00 Dublin | 21:30–23:00 SGT
Day B: 11:00–12:30 ET | 16:00–17:30 Dublin | 23:00–00:30 SGT
Day C: 07:00–08:30 ET | 12:00–13:30 Dublin | 19:00–20:30 SGT

Notes / constraints:
- We avoid APAC midnight hours for the load tests because of potential backup overlap; Mina — can you confirm concurrency caps for SG region on those dates?
- If the Singapore team cannot do the late kickoff, we can flip to an earlier kickoff for US/EU and run a recorded technical deep-dive for APAC with a follow-up live Q&A in their morning.

Next steps:
- Liam: confirm preferred kickoff day (we suggest July 28 for internal prep).
- Kestrel: flag any immutable blackout windows.
- Redwood: I’ll send a tentative calendar grid + invite links once Mina confirms infra windows.

Regards,
